This listing includes two multi-packs of Maxell UR 90 audio cassette tapes: a 24-pack and a 20-pack, all factory sealed. These are Type I (normal bias) blank tapes with 90 minutes (135m/443ft) of recording time each. The cassettes have clear shells with red and white Maxell branding and feature the classic Maxell 'blown-away man' artwork on the packaging. Both packs are unopened and in excellent condition, with minor shelf wear on the boxes. Ideal for collectors, vintage audio users, or those needing blank recording media.
